question: What claim is made about the transmission of the practice of the soul to the addressed Bhairavī?
premises: This practice of the soul is indicated.
It has been told to you.
The statement is addressed to Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: No details of the practice are given in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
